kernelExperiment.change: Stage the Q8 reduce kernel's row maximum and per-part softmax weights in threadgroup memory instead of recomputing them in all 256 threads of the row (256x fewer exp calls per row).
kernelExperiment.outcome: NOT ADOPTED. Build and checks pass and the greedy output is byte-identical, but two runs of the staged kernel (12.14 and 11.71 decode tok/s, mean 11.93) are indistinguishable from the five runs of the shipped kernel (11.84-11.96, mean 11.90). The redundant exps are not on the critical path at this context, so the pinned runtime stays 0.2.20-q8.1.
